baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of the one who does not answer with the caller of God.
baseline_models.mechanism: A voiced summons initiates an address-response circuit, and answering supplies its return leg. Refusal is therefore not mere inactivity but a broken exchange whose initiating call remains present.

activation_trace.role: Replying speech supplies the return leg that would complete the caller-addressee exchange.
A vocal summons that inclines its hearer supplies the initiating movement of the exchange.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns failure to obey a divine messenger.
changed_reading.after: The verse first depicts a failed address-response circuit: the summons reaches an addressee, but the addressee withholds the return that would complete it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatically negated active participle in the construction concerning the earth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The active participle can picture a fugitive trying to make a pursuer fail by outstripping or eluding pursuit. The earth is the whole bounded chase-space, so the denial is stronger than a generic lack of power.

activation_trace.role: Present-state negation, reinforced in its predicate, excludes both successful escape and available patronage.
Outstripping a seeker and slipping beyond capture supplies the verse's pursuit mechanics.
The terrestrial expanse below the sky supplies the complete field across which flight is denied.

changed_reading.before: The nonrespondent is not powerful enough to defeat God.
changed_reading.after: The nonrespondent cannot make the seeker fail by outrunning, evading, or leaving reach anywhere in the terrestrial field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second negation, the possessive construction, and the phrase locating patrons apart from God.
baseline_models.mechanism: Nearness, custodial authority, and active support converge in the patron term. The verse clears the relational space around the nonrespondent: no lesser or alternative figure can stand close, take charge, or interpose aid.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that remains short of the ultimate endpoint supplies the position of a putative intermediary.
Otherness and lesser rank define the alternative sphere from which help is denied.
Unseparated proximity supplies the imagined patron's position beside the endangered person.
Taking charge of another's affairs supplies the custodial function that no patron can perform.
Affectionate alliance and active aid supply the rescue function explicitly emptied out.

changed_reading.before: The person simply has no allies besides God.
changed_reading.after: The verse removes an entire protective topology: no nearby subordinate patron can assume custody, intercede by position, or mobilize aid.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The enclosure construction joining lostness to a participle of disclosure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lostness can involve departure from a route, disappearance, or failure to locate what is lost, while the final modifier makes something appear. Their conjunction produces a paradoxical condition: refusal hides the route but exposes the refuser's disorientation.

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the primary path failure.
Disappearance into concealment supplies the inward hiddenness of the lost condition.
Emergence into visibility turns inward disorientation into an inspectable condition.
Separation after connection gives the exposed lostness a relational edge as well as cognitive error.

changed_reading.before: The ending says only that the error is obvious.
changed_reading.after: The ending stages lostness becoming self-disclosing: the route is hidden from the refuser while the refusal makes the separation visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier scene asks who is more lost than one who calls substitutes that cannot answer; the focus scene reverses the grammatical roles, presenting a true caller whom a human will not answer. Failed response therefore operates reciprocally: false objects cannot return a false call, while the accountable subject refuses to return the true call.

activation_trace.role: Repeated calling speech supplies the earlier outward address toward substitute objects.
The absent verbal return supplies the failed response at the object end of the earlier circuit.
Deviation from right direction classifies the earlier misdirected call as lostness.
The focus summons supplies the true initiating address against which the earlier address is reversed.
Withheld reply relocates failed response from an incapable object to a responsible human subject.
The repeated path failure closes both sides of the reversal under one diagnosis.

structural_cues: Both scenes open their descriptions with an indefinite human relative and organize judgment around call plus nonresponse.
Agent and patient roles reverse: the earlier human calls an unresponsive object, whereas the focus human is the unresponsive addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching call, answer, and lostness roots with reversed grammatical roles. I infer a reciprocal failure circuit connecting the scenes; a live alternative is ordinary thematic repetition without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse introduces an independent warning about disobedience.
changed_reading.after: The focus verse answers the earlier failed invocation by reversal: the deepest lostness is both calling what cannot answer and refusing the Caller who truly addresses you.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding command couples answering and trusting with two effects: covering trailing wrongs and entering protective custody from punishment. The focus consequence supplies the inverse pair: refusal leaves neither self-evasion nor substitute custody. Response is thus a transfer into protection, not a bare verbal acknowledgment.

activation_trace.role: The imperative to return an answer supplies the threshold action for the promised transition.
The spoken summons supplies the relational entry point rather than an abstract proposition.
Heart-settling trust supplies the inward uptake paired with outward answer.
Covering a wrong while shielding its bearer from its effect supplies the first protective result.
A trailing end supplies the image of consequences following behind the respondent and then being covered.
Protected adjacency under another's custody supplies the second promised result.
Inflicted punitive pain supplies the danger from which protective custody delivers.
Failed evasion supplies the loss of self-protection when the threshold action is refused.
Unavailable supportive alliance supplies the loss of proxy protection.

structural_cues: The positive imperatives and paired promises of 46:31 are immediately followed by the negative human case and paired denials of 46:32.
Within the focus verse, the consequence marker before the first negation links nonresponse to failed escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies answer plus trust followed by covering plus custody, then refusal followed by no escape plus no patrons. I infer a route contrast, response leading into protection and refusal into exposure; a live alternative treats the promises and threat as adjacent but independently phrased outcomes.

changed_reading.before: Answering is compliance rewarded later, while nonanswer is separately punished.
changed_reading.after: Answering is the threshold into covering and protective custody; refusing it leaves both the trailing consequences uncovered and every self-made or proxy escape unavailable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The listener episode orders reception, attentive silence, completion, reorientation toward a community, warning, and then the command to answer. The caller of God can therefore be read as a relay position: genuine hearing turns recipients into transmitters without turning them into substitute patrons.

activation_trace.role: Hearing that becomes understanding and compliance supplies effective reception rather than sound alone.
Recitation supplies the transmissible discourse entering the listeners.
Listening silence supplies the disciplined receptive phase of the relay.
Completion and coming to an end supply the pivot from reception to retransmission.
Turning one's orientation supplies the relay's pivot back toward the listeners' own people.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the purpose of the outward transmission.
The resulting summons supplies the next outward link in the relay.
The demanded return supplies the receiving community's opportunity to continue the relay.
The absent custodial patron distinguishes faithful transmission from replacing God with an intermediary authority.

structural_cues: Two successive completion clauses order the episode as hearing, silence, completion, turning, and warning before the direct call in 46:31.
The same root later naming patrons first appears as the listeners' bodily and social reorientation toward their people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered reception-to-warning sequence immediately before the answer command. I infer reception leading to communal retransmission, while keeping God as the call's source; a live alternative is that the narrative describes one delegation without defining a general relay mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The caller is a single external voice whom each hearer either obeys or ignores.
changed_reading.after: The caller occupies a relay position: effective hearing turns recipients toward their own community as warners, while refusal halts transmission and cannot be repaired by substitute custodians.

context_deltas.mechanism: A people can possess hearing, sight, and inward hearts while those faculties avail nothing because known signs are denied. Against the later listeners whose hearing becomes comprehension, answering the caller is effective uptake and enacted acknowledgment, not acoustic receipt.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance distinguish effective hearing from the merely possessed faculty repeated in the verse.
Inner discernment supplies a second capacity that can exist without changing conduct.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies the center where heard meaning could become commitment.
Practical sufficiency supplies the missing effect: the faculties did not protect or benefit their possessors.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the volitional blockage between perception and response.
Hearing that reaches understanding and compliance supplies the contrasting successful uptake.
Returning an answer names the outward completion of inward uptake.

structural_cues: The three faculties are first granted and then repeated possessively in the statement that they availed nothing.
The later listener episode supplies a controlled contrast in which hearing is followed by attentive conduct and warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intact faculties, conscious denial, and a contrasting case of hearing followed by action. I infer that answer means effective uptake across perception, heart, and conduct; a live alternative is that answer retains its ordinary command sense without a technical faculty model.

changed_reading.before: Failure to answer could be heard as failure to receive or understand the message.
changed_reading.after: The nonanswer is a blocked conversion of available perception into commitment: sound reaches the ear, but no answer returns through the heart and act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The supposed near-making deities fail to help, go missing from their adherents, and eventually stand as enemies. The focus denial of patrons is therefore dynamic rather than merely numerical: the substitute support network collapses, disappears, and can reverse polarity.

activation_trace.role: Aid that makes its recipient prevail supplies the rescue function the substitutes fail to perform.
An offering intended to produce nearness supplies the adherents' attempted access mechanism.
A lesser alternative sphere locates the attempted access outside God.
Disappearance into absence supplies the patrons' failure at the moment aid is needed.
Active enmity supplies the final reversal of a relationship once imagined as supportive.
The same lesser alternative sphere is emptied of every effective patron in the focus conclusion.
Supportive alliance supplies the precise relationship whose collapse the prior scenes narrate.

structural_cues: The phrase locating substitutes apart from God recurs in 46:4, 46:5, 46:28, and the focus verse.
The patron history moves from being invoked, to failing help and disappearing, to becoming enemies at gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted nearness, failed aid, disappearance, and eventual enmity. I infer that no patrons summarizes a relational collapse and reversal; a live alternative reads it as the simpler assertion that no true patrons ever existed.

changed_reading.before: No allies means that an otherwise stable support network is absent at judgment.
changed_reading.after: The support network proves structurally false: its members cannot aid, vanish under demand, and may reappear only as enemies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The advancing formation is read as welcome rain but becomes a dominating wind that crosses valley space, destroys, and leaves dwellings as visible residue; nearby settlements repeat the pattern. This gives the focus pursuit a material landscape: apparent refuge or favorable weather can invert, movement across terrain does not outrun the event, and places left behind become evidence.

activation_trace.role: Something emerging visibly from one side supplies the approaching object's deceptive first appearance.
A channel cut for flowing movement supplies the terrain into which the threat advances.
Water descending from cloud supplies the inhabitants' favorable expectation.
Descent as punishment supplies the live reversal hidden inside the expected rain image.
Wind as force and dominance supplies the pursuing agency that fills the landscape.
Comprehensive destruction supplies the endpoint of the advancing force.
Inhabited dwellings supply the stationary residue visible after their occupants are gone.
Collapse into destruction supplies the repeated outcome across settlements.
Every direction around the audience expands the example into a surrounding geographic field.
People gathered into settlements supply multiple social places within that field.
Failure to outrun pursuit converts the landscape episode into an escape model.
The whole terrestrial domain gathers valleys, dwellings, and surrounding settlements into one chase-space.

structural_cues: The narrative moves through seeing, naming, correction, destruction, residual visibility, and then nearby ruined settlements.
The focus verse follows this geographic sequence after the responsive listeners have already drawn its warning forward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an advancing force, valley terrain, destroyed dwellings, and surrounding settlements. I infer that this episode materially models failed flight across the earth; a live alternative keeps the focus threat primarily eschatological and treats the storm only as a nearby precedent.

changed_reading.before: The earth is an abstract universal location in a legal claim that escape is impossible.
changed_reading.after: The earth becomes a populated chase-space of valleys and settlements where seeming refuge can reverse into the pursuing force and abandoned places remain as evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse denies incapacity or fatigue in creation and affirms enabling power to restore the dead. Read against that polarity, the focus active participle marks an impossible transfer of incapacity: the human may fail to answer, but cannot make divine agency fail or pass beyond its capacity.

activation_trace.role: Incapacity before the required course of action supplies the condition explicitly denied of the Creator.
Effective capacity reaching action and mastery supplies the positive pole opposite incapacity.
A measure that brings things to their limit supplies the bounded order within which human flight occurs.
Bringing created reality into existence supplies the demonstrated scale of the asserted capacity.
Loss of life supplies the apparently terminal state that divine capacity can reverse.
Weakness and inability supply the state the nonrespondent cannot impose on divine action.
Outstripping the seeker supplies the attempted mechanism for making that action fail.

structural_cues: The focus denial is followed immediately by a rhetorical question denying divine weariness and a concluding affirmation of capacity.
The next verse pairs first creation with renewed life, widening pursuit beyond present terrestrial movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit incapacity-capacity polarity immediately after the failed-escape claim. I infer that the focus participle transitively imagines trying to make divine pursuit fail; a live alternative retains the simpler intransitive sense of being unable to escape.

changed_reading.before: The person cannot escape because divine power is generally greater.
changed_reading.after: The person who fails to answer cannot reverse roles and make divine agency fail: even death is not a boundary outside the Creator's measured capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disclosure root repeatedly qualifies signs, the opponents' label of magic, a warner, and finally lostness. In the quoted rejection scene, clear signs are verbally reclassified as clear magic; this makes the focus modifier diagnostic, because the rejecting speech itself discloses the speaker's deviation.

activation_trace.role: Visible clarity supplies both the signs' presentation and the opponents' competing characterization.
Meaning disclosed through speech makes the opponents' own utterance evidence about their orientation.
An overtly spoken judgment supplies the act through which inner rejection becomes inspectable.
Deflecting deception supplies the false category imposed on the disclosed signs.
A warning intended to awaken caution supplies another disclosed function the audience can misclassify.
Communicative disclosure qualifies the warner and links clarity to address rather than spectacle alone.
Deviation from intended direction supplies the condition disclosed by misclassification and nonresponse.
Coming into view turns the final modifier into a verdict of exposure.

structural_cues: The same disclosure root recurs as a modifier of signs, alleged magic, the warner, and the focus lostness.
In 46:7 the audience's direct quotation places received clarity and its false relabeling in one speech event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated modifiers and a quoted act of relabeling. I infer that the modifier migrates into a diagnostic verdict, with rejection disclosing the rejecter; a live alternative is that the repetitions are ordinary adjectival emphasis without this reflexive function.

changed_reading.before: The final modifier merely increases the degree of obvious error.
changed_reading.after: The modifier marks error exposed through response: the hearer's own relabeling and refusal make an otherwise inward deviation publicly legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Standing straight, being gently led to truth, taking an extended path, and persisting with fixed resolve form a locomotor alternative to being enclosed in lostness. Answering the caller becomes reorientation onto a traversable route rather than assent to a detached claim.

activation_trace.role: Upright alignment and straightness supply the stable bodily posture opposite wandering.
Gentle direction toward a route and truth supplies the guidance movement entering the call.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the route's named destination.
An extended traversable way supplies the spatial form of the offered orientation.
Holding to an intended course and continuing along it supplies durable movement after orientation.
Departure from intended direction supplies the contrary locomotor state caused by nonresponse.
Visible disclosure makes the contrast between route and wandering inspectable.

structural_cues: The statement that the recited book guides to truth and a straight path immediately precedes the command to answer.
The closing command to persist like resolute messengers extends the path model beyond the initial turn.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uprightness, guidance, a straight path, and persistence on a course. I infer an orientation-to-traversal mechanism for answering; a live alternative treats these as related guidance metaphors without a single locomotor sequence.

changed_reading.before: Lostness is a static doctrinal category assigned after refusal.
changed_reading.after: Lostness is failed orientation and movement: the call opens a straight course toward truth, while nonresponse leaves the person traveling without the route.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed endpoint bounds the warning from the opening, while the conclusion forbids haste and compresses apparent worldly duration to an hour of a day. Joined to failed flight across the earth, these cues close a second escape route: delay, lingering, or waiting for distance in time cannot make the summons expire.

activation_trace.role: A prescribed endpoint of duration supplies the outer temporal boundary of warning and response.
Acceleration and bringing something forward supply the explicitly rejected attempt to force timing.
A bounded span of time supplies the scale against which former duration is compressed.
Remaining in a place or state supplies the duration retrospectively reduced to almost nothing.
Outrunning pursuit supplies the spatial escape model extended here into attempted temporal delay.
Terrestrial space supplies one axis of enclosure beside the newly activated temporal axis.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a named term and closes by comparing the interval before fulfillment to only an hour of a day.
The final prohibition on hastening preserves an interval for response without making the endpoint defeasible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed term, rejected haste, and compressed remembered duration. I infer that failed escape extends from spatial evasion to postponement; a live alternative limits the focus wording to spatial and social reach while leaving temporal closure to the wider context.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies escape anywhere in space but says nothing about delay.
changed_reading.after: The nonrespondent cannot evade by distance or duration: the earth bounds movement, the fixed term bounds delay, and long residence contracts when fulfillment arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates side branches of the repeated negator and the earth term rather than their ordinary syntactic senses. It remains anchored in the two negations, the earthly field, and failed flight, where the images cohere as bodily confinement. Downstream prose should call it an imagistic pressure, not claim that the negator literally means immobilization here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated negator surrounding the claim about failed flight in the earth.

activation_trace.role: A person who stays and does not leave a place supplies an image of the negations fastening the fugitive in position.
Clinging and growing heavy toward the ground supplies the bodily weight of confinement.
Attempted flight beyond the seeker supplies the motion that the stasis images arrest.

changed_reading.before: No escape is an abstract legal denial.
changed_reading.after: The doubled denial exerts the pressure of two clamps: the fugitive is weighted to the earthly field and cannot leave the pursuit relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the answer root from its ordinary speech branch into piercing, opening, and disclosure branches. It remains anchored in the focus call-answer pair and in the final movement from concealed lostness to visibility. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for response, not as the lexical gloss of the verb in this construction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The answer verb between the divine caller and the final disclosed lostness.

activation_trace.role: A cut that penetrates through material supplies response as passage rather than sound alone.
An opened gap or clearing supplies the aperture made by effective answer.
Illumination and unveiling supply what can enter through the responsive opening.
The inclining vocal call supplies the force arriving at the unopened boundary.
Emergence into visibility supplies the disclosure refused at the aperture but realized in the diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: Answering is verbal compliance with an external summons.
changed_reading.after: Answering can be pictured as opening a passage through which the summons becomes disclosure; refusal leaves the subject closed to guidance yet exposed in lostness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the adjacent protection verb's QAC root resolves to a non-dominant mapped root whose branch concerns mending a break on crookedness. The activation remains valid as packet-supplied split-root material and connects visibly to the focus path failure and absent aid. Downstream prose should qualify it as a secondary repair echo, never as the direct lexical meaning of the protection verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The absent supportive patrons and the focus state of deviation, read beside the protection promise in 46:31.

activation_trace.role: Protective adjacency and custody supply the dominant shelter image of the promise.
Mending a fracture set on crookedness supplies an exploratory restorative layer within that shelter.
Deviation from the intended line supplies the crooked condition potentially repaired.
Supportive alliance supplies the aid unavailable once the offered protection and repair are refused.

changed_reading.before: The adjacent promise offers shelter from punishment and nothing more.
changed_reading.after: The shelter may carry a contained repair image: answer opens custody that can mend deviation, whereas refusal leaves both the break and the absence of aid in place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a non-dominant mapped root behind the answer verb, joining collection and selection to the gathered listening group. It remains anchored in the packet's split mapping, the focus answer, and the immediate reception-to-community sequence. Downstream prose should render it as a social image prompted by the split root, not redefine answering as etymologically identical with gathering or selection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The answer verb and the loss of nearby patronage, read after a group gathers around recitation and returns to its people.

activation_trace.role: Collecting and bringing material together supplies an exploratory social cohesion produced by answer.
Selection and being brought near supply an exploratory transition from hearer to responsive participant.
Gathering and assembly supply a parallel image for listeners collected around the recitation.
A mobilized supportive group supplies the communal body that can carry the warning outward.
Unseparated proximity supplies the relational nearness lost by the refusing subject.

changed_reading.before: Answer is an individual reply whose only alternative is individual punishment.
changed_reading.after: Answer may also image being gathered and brought near into a transmitting community; refusal forfeits that responsive proximity without creating substitute patrons.

strongest_changes: The call-answer failure in 46:5 reverses in 46:32, moving nonresponse from an incapable invoked object to an accountable human addressee.
The 46:31-32 sequence turns answer into entry under covering and protective custody, with refusal producing both failed self-escape and failed proxy protection.
The 46:29-31 listener sequence makes the caller a relay position in which effective hearing becomes warning and renewed call.
The patron scenes turn no patrons from static absence into a network that fails, disappears, and reverses into enmity.
The storm geography and the following capacity claim give failed escape material and agentive depth: no terrain outruns the event, and the respondent cannot impose incapacity on the Creator.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse sustained several coexisting mechanics rather than one consensus gloss: reciprocal speech, terrestrial pursuit, protective topology, perceptual uptake, disclosed path failure, and temporal closure. Split-root activations added contained images of aperture, repair, collection, and selected proximity without displacing the stronger branch-backed readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The reciprocal design between 46:5 and 46:32 may be deliberate role reversal or only strong thematic recurrence.
The final disclosure modifier may diagnose rejection reflexively, or it may function as ordinary adjectival emphasis.
The storm sequence may materially model the focus pursuit, or it may remain only a nearby historical precedent for the threat.
The aperture, repair, and gathered-proximity readings depend on form-distant or non-dominant branches and must remain imagistic rather than lexical claims.
